summary: It's a Wonderful World is a card-drafting engine builder where every player drafts from the same rotating hand simultaneously, then decides whether to recycle each card for immediate resources or build it for ongoing production and points. The simultaneous draft-and-plan structure keeps downtime low even though most of the actual building happens in parallel on personal empire boards.
praised: clever simultaneous drafting keeps everyone engaged
criticised: mostly parallel play with limited direct interaction
some randomness in which cards appear
feels similar to 7 Wonders/Res Arcana to experienced gamers

interaction.kind: simultaneous drafting, mostly parallel empire building
interaction.detail: Each player builds their own tableau of construction cards and produces resources independently, so the boards themselves are not shared. Interaction happens only at the draft: cards are picked from hands passed around the table, so taking a card you want denies it to everyone else, but there is no common market, attack, or trading.

sources: VP printed on constructed development cards
era-end achievement tiles for resource production majorities
scoring.how_you_win: Each era, players draft cards and simultaneously choose to recycle them for resources or construct them into their empire for ongoing production and printed VP; after four eras, era achievement bonuses for resource majorities are added and the highest total score wins.
